title: The meaning of cross and resurrection

body: “Jesus’ death on the cross represented God’s boundless solidarity with victims, even unto death. Jesus’ resurrection is the good news that there is new life for the poor that is not determined by their poverty but overcomes it; and this new life is available to all. Jesus’ resurrection is God’s victory over oppression.” – James Cone
